host_preflight.host_idleness_scope: User allows shared CPU builds and other jobs; only positive direct-mask overlap with GPUs0-2 blocks, unknown mappings observed without blocking; no physical-host isolation or capacity guarantee
host_preflight.existing_gpu_lock_qualification: Existing canonical lock acquired and held by current coordinator under explicit root instruction

gpu_lock_held_proof.scope: Existing canonical advisory lock held by coordinator; owned groups serial, shared disjoint activity allowed; no physical-host lease

host_preflight.native_admission_guard: unchanged frozen native binary and limits; no admission override flags
host_preflight.host_ram_class: physical host RAM from /proc/meminfo; DIMM/ECC class not inferred

continuous_collision_guard.scope: Positive direct-mask GPU0-2 overlap scan; CPU/HTTP/shared and unknown mappings observed without blocking, own groups excluded; no physical-host isolation claim
